name: Sawami Inori
source:
Honest, responsible, and reliable; She's the head of the dormitory despite being a sophomore. She is completely unable to overlook anyone in trouble, and is intolerant of crooked behavior.
Contrary to her dignified appearance, she is an enthusiastic girl with a cheerful and open-minded temperament. 
She has a highly forceful personality and, for better or worse, she has a strong influence on others. This is how she brings people together and is always at the center of attention.
